"""Tests for PropScan core functionality."""

import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
import subprocess

from propscan.core import (
    FlatpakManager, PacmanManager, AptManager, DnfManager,
    ProprietaryDatabase, PropScan
)


class TestPackageManagers(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test package manager implementations."""
    
    def test_flatpak_manager_init(self):
        """Test FlatpakManager initialization."""
        manager = FlatpakManager()
        self.assertEqual(manager.name, "Flatpak")
        self.assertEqual(manager.command, "flatpak")
    
    def test_pacman_manager_init(self):
        """Test PacmanManager initialization."""
        manager = PacmanManager()
        self.assertEqual(manager.name, "Pacman")
        self.assertEqual(manager.command, "pacman")
    
    def test_apt_manager_init(self):
        """Test AptManager initialization."""
        manager = AptManager()
        self.assertEqual(manager.name, "APT")
        self.assertEqual(manager.command, "apt")
    
    def test_dnf_manager_init(self):
        """Test DnfManager initialization."""
        manager = DnfManager()
        self.assertEqual(manager.name, "DNF")
        self.assertEqual(manager.command, "dnf")
    
    @patch('shutil.which')
    def test_is_available_true(self, mock_which):
        """Test package manager availability check when available."""
        mock_which.return_value = "/usr/bin/flatpak"
        manager = FlatpakManager()
        self.assertTrue(manager.is_available())
    
    @patch('shutil.which')
    def test_is_available_false(self, mock_which):
        """Test package manager availability check when not available."""
        mock_which.return_value = None
        manager = FlatpakManager()
        self.assertFalse(manager.is_available())
    
    @patch('subprocess.run')
    def test_flatpak_get_packages(self, mock_run):
        """Test Flatpak package listing."""
        mock_run.return_value = MagicMock(
            stdout="Application ID\tName\tVersion\ncom.spotify.Client\tSpotify\t1.2.3\n",
            returncode=0
        )
        
        manager = FlatpakManager()
        packages = manager.get_installed_packages()
        
        self.assertEqual(len(packages), 1)
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["name"], "com.spotify.Client")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["display_name"], "Spotify")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["version"], "1.2.3")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["manager"], "flatpak")
    
    @patch('subprocess.run')
    def test_pacman_get_packages(self, mock_run):
        """Test Pacman package listing."""
        mock_run.return_value = MagicMock(
            stdout="google-chrome 91.0.4472.77-1\nfirefox 89.0-1\n",
            returncode=0
        )
        
        manager = PacmanManager()
        packages = manager.get_installed_packages()
        
        self.assertEqual(len(packages), 2)
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["name"], "google-chrome")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["version"], "91.0.4472.77-1")
        self.assertEqual(packages[0]["manager"], "pacman")


class TestProprietaryDatabase(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test proprietary software database."""
    
    def test_default_database(self):
        """Test default proprietary database."""
        db = ProprietaryDatabase()
        self.assertIsInstance(db.proprietary_packages, set)
        self.assertGreater(len(db.proprietary_packages), 0)
    
    def test_is_proprietary_exact_match(self):
        """Test exact match for proprietary software."""
        db = ProprietaryDatabase()
        self.assertTrue(db.is_proprietary("google-chrome"))
        self.assertTrue(db.is_proprietary("discord"))
        self.assertFalse(db.is_proprietary("firefox"))
    
    def test_is_proprietary_partial_match(self):
        """Test partial match for proprietary software."""
        db = ProprietaryDatabase()
        self.assertTrue(db.is_proprietary("google-chrome-stable"))
        self.assertTrue(db.is_proprietary("com.spotify.Client"))


class TestPropScan(unittest.TestCase):
    """Test main PropScan functionality."""
    
    def setUp(self):
        """Set up test fixtures."""
        self.scanner = PropScan()
    
    @patch.object(FlatpakManager, 'is_available')
    @patch.object(PacmanManager, 'is_available')
    @patch.object(AptManager, 'is_available')
    @patch.object(DnfManager, 'is_available')
    def test_get_available_managers(self, mock_dnf, mock_apt, mock_pacman, mock_flatpak):
        """Test getting available package managers."""
        mock_flatpak.return_value = True
        mock_pacman.return_value = False
        mock_apt.return_value = True
        mock_dnf.return_value = False
        
        available = self.scanner.get_available_managers()
        self.assertEqual(len(available), 2)
        self.assertEqual(available[0].name, "Flatpak")
        self.assertEqual(available[1].name, "APT")
    
    @patch.object(FlatpakManager, 'get_installed_packages')
    def test_scan_manager(self, mock_get_packages):
        """Test scanning a specific manager."""
        mock_get_packages.return_value = [
            {"name": "google-chrome", "display_name": "Google Chrome", "version": "91.0", "manager": "flatpak"},
            {"name": "firefox", "display_name": "Firefox", "version": "89.0", "manager": "flatpak"}
        ]
        
        manager = FlatpakManager()
        proprietary = self.scanner.scan_manager(manager)
        
        self.assertEqual(len(proprietary), 1)
        self.assertEqual(proprietary[0]["name"], "google-chrome")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
